weight_mode: Adaptive area times variance at sample time; refreshed once per GP version and frozen within search
run_end: Reserve return time within the scenario budget and sense through Home arrival.
initial_gp: RBF prior with a fixed mean, fitted covariance and noise, and zero observations.
reconstruction: Final posterior on the scenario and common-support grids.
gp_update: Every 1 s; all observations retained; fixed kernel hyperparameters
grg_update: Single worker, one replaceable latest-state signal, no FIFO; current search completes, next search starts with latest offered GP/context
goal_switch: Switch sampling goals only at arrival and retain the sampling route tail. Home is reserved for spawn and final return.
execution_mode: Background latest-GP search with arrival-only waypoint switching.
terminal_residual: Keep all valid sampling and return measurements through Home arrival; stop offering GRG searches at return dispatch.
